title: Build WorkflowDetailPage with info, runs history, and metrics
description:
No workflow detail page exists. WorkflowsPage links to `/workflows/:id` but the route target is missing.

**Implementation:**
- Create `dashboard/src/pages/WorkflowDetailPage.tsx`
- Fetch workflow by ID using `useWorkflow(id)` from `hooks/useWorkflows.ts`
- Show: workflow name, trigger type badge, step count, timeout, metadata, created/updated times
- Show step list with type icons and dependency visualization (simple list, not full DAG)
- Show recent runs table (last 20) using `useWorkflowRuns(workflowId)` — reuse RunStatusBadge
- Add "Run Now" button (POST to create run), "Edit" button (navigate to edit page)
- Back navigation to /workflows

**Files:** `dashboard/src/pages/WorkflowDetailPage.tsx` (new), `dashboard/src/App.tsx` (add route)
definitionOfDone: WorkflowDetailPage renders workflow info and step list
Recent runs table shows run history
Run Now button triggers workflow execution
